identity: Bounded self-reconstruction study of PI-STHNN; not author code
window_hypothesis_limit: These windows match ceil(0.8*all complete windows) in Table2, contradicting Table3W30. Arithmetic matching is not confirmation of author preprocessing. Never use random overlapping-window validation to match counts.
split: Original engine-disjoint80/20 split, seed42; fitting-only graph and scaler
common_validation: For every method, evaluate only engine-cycle endpoints at or beyond the implied window of that subset. Assert identical (unit,cycle,label) hashes across methods.
training: 50 complete epochs, batch256, MSE, Adam, StepLR50/gamma0.1; lr/wd from previously locked stage2 choices; LSTM dropout0; RULcap125

method_details.paper_window: Final long-window reconstruction with softmax fusion; all other adopted parameters unchanged

checkpoint: Minimum RMSE on common internal validation endpoints; no early stopping or test-label selection
selection: One common method for ALL4 subsets. Eligible if all4 screen jobs finish finitely, mean relative validation RMSE vs matched control <=-2%, at least2 subsets improve >=1%, and no subset worsens >3%. Lowest mean relative RMSE wins; exact ties preserve listed order.
no_candidate_passes: Stop with a negative-result report. No automatic expansion or official-test search.
candidate_passes: Lock one method, then run matched control and selected method from scratch across all4 subsets and all5 fixed seeds:40 full runs, common validation protocol, one official endpoint per engine after checkpoint choice.
budget: 20 source-only screen runs; at most40 subsequent full matched runs
official_label_policy: No official test features or labels during screen/selection. No seed replacement. Failed runs retained, no silent retries.
resource_policy: One CUDA worker; wait for >=2200MiB free before each job; never terminate unrelated processes
interpretation: Internal exploratory reconstruction plus retrospective official comparison. Neither independent validation nor guaranteed published-RMSE replication. Existing results and frozen baseline remain unchanged.
